mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals labor market tightening that accelerates inflation, triggering Federal Reserve rate hikes and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, elevating corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a supply shock that reduces corporate output and increases input costs, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates economic expansion that boosts corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market participants price in stronger earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that forces Federal Reserve tightening, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market overheating that accelerates inflation, triggering monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS) above 0.5% monthly signals elevated consumer spending that increases corporate revenue visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises above 0.5% MoM.
